input: Parse /var/log/access.log to find the top 3 most requested URL paths. Each line has format 'METHOD /path STATUS'. Print each URL with its count, sorted by count descending.

transcript.final_response:
These are the 3 most requested URL paths in `/var/log/access.log`:

| Rank | URL path | Requests |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | /api/items | 4 |
| 1 | /api/users | 4 |
| 3 | /api/health | 2 |

The log has 10 lines. `/api/items` and `/api/users` are tied for first, so I listed them alphabetically. Counts include every HTTP method; for example, `/api/items` covers both GET and POST requests.

Command used:
```bash
awk '{print $2}' /var/log/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3
```
tool_calls: head -5 /var/log/access.log; wc -l /var/log/access.log; awk '{print $2}' /var/log/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3
